An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Jeeva Natarajan (mobile 9000000002) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00181, as the mobile number 9000000002 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
